constellations.name: Orion
constellations.story: Orion is one of the most recognizable constellations, marked by three bright belt stars.

constellations.name: Ursa Major
constellations.story: Ursa Major contains the Big Dipper asterism, often used for navigation.

constellations.name: Ursa Minor
constellations.story: Ursa Minor contains Polaris, the North Star.

constellations.name: Cassiopeia
constellations.story: Cassiopeia is famous for its W-shaped pattern.

constellations.name: Scorpius
constellations.story: Scorpius curves across the sky with red Antares marking the heart of the scorpion.

constellations.name: Cygnus
constellations.story: Cygnus is the Swan and forms part of the Summer Triangle.

constellations.name: Lyra
constellations.story: Lyra is small but prominent because of bright Vega.

constellations.name: Aquila
constellations.story: Aquila represents the Eagle and includes Altair in the Summer Triangle.

constellations.name: Taurus
constellations.story: Taurus contains the Hyades and Pleiades star clusters.

constellations.name: Gemini
constellations.story: Gemini is represented by the twins Castor and Pollux.

constellations.name: Leo
constellations.story: Leo is recognized by the Sickle asterism and bright Regulus.

constellations.name: Virgo
constellations.story: Virgo is a large zodiac constellation containing the Virgo Cluster of galaxies.

constellations.name: Crux
constellations.story: Crux, the Southern Cross, is a key navigation constellation in the southern sky.

constellations.name: Centaurus
constellations.story: Centaurus contains Alpha Centauri, the closest star system to the Sun.

constellations.name: Carina
constellations.story: Carina contains Canopus, the second brightest star in the night sky.

constellations.name: Sagittarius
constellations.story: Sagittarius points toward the center of the Milky Way.

constellations.name: Andromeda
constellations.story: Andromeda hosts the Andromeda Galaxy, the nearest large spiral galaxy.

constellations.name: Pegasus
constellations.story: Pegasus is known for the Great Square asterism.

constellations.name: Canis Major
constellations.story: Canis Major contains Sirius, the brightest star in the night sky.

constellations.name: Canis Minor
constellations.story: Canis Minor is a small constellation marked by bright Procyon.
